weeks.content:
Plant beans in cotton and water them
Watch roots and shoots grow

Water, air, sunlight and soil
One pot in the dark, one in the sun

Ants, bees and butterflies
Watch ants march in a line

Uses of water at home and school
Do not waste water

Pick up pins with a magnet
Sort magnetic and non magnetic things

Push the door, pull the drawer
Play push and pull games

Make hand shadows with the torch
Shadows follow the light

Build a boat that floats
Which load sinks my boat

Sunny, cloudy, rainy days
Mark the weather every morning

Show my plant or boat
Talk about what I discovered
